title: Morning wake-up time
prompt: What time does the speaker wake up?
hint: Look for the line that says "I wake up at ..." in the example.

ja.prompt: 話者は何時に起きますか？
ja.hint: 例の「I wake up at ...」という文を見てください。

local.hint: 請查看範例中寫著“I wake up at ...”的句子。

local_pron.hint: qǐng chá kàn fànlì zhōng de “I wake up at ...” jùzi.

zh.hint: 查看示例句中‘I wake up at ...’的时间。

en.prompt: What time does the speaker wake up?
en.hint: Find the sentence that begins 'I wake up at ...' in the example.

en_pron.prompt: What time does the speaker wake up? (pronunciation help)
en_pron.hint: Look for 'I wake up at 6 AM every day.'

title: Avoiding morning rushing
prompt: What does packing your bag the night before help you avoid?
hint: Refer to the sentence about packing the bag and preparing clothes the night before.

ja.prompt: 前の晩にバッグを詰めることは何を防ぎますか？
ja.hint: 『前の晩にバッグを詰めたり服を準備したりすると、朝に急ぐことを避けられます。』という文を見てください。
ja.sample: 慌てるのを避けられます。

local.prompt: 前一晚整理書包能幫你避免什麼？
local.hint: 參考『前一晚整理書包和準備衣服幫助我避免早晨匆忙』這句話。

local_pron.prompt: qián yī wǎn zhěnglǐ shūbāo néng bāng nǐ bìmiǎn shénme?
local_pron.hint: cān kǎo “qián yī wǎn zhěnglǐ shūbāo hé zhǔnbèi yīfú bāngzhù wǒ bìmiǎn zǎochén cōngmáng” zhè jù huà.

zh.prompt: 前一晚整理书包能帮助你避免什么？
zh.hint: 参看“前一晚整理书包和准备衣服帮助我避免早晨匆忙。”这句。

en.prompt: What does packing your bag the night before help you avoid?
en.hint: Look at the example sentence about packing the bag and preparing clothes the night before.

en_pron.prompt: What does packing your bag the night before help you avoid? (pronunciation help)
en_pron.hint: See 'Packing my bag ... helps me avoid rushing in the morning.'

title: A stressful event
prompt: When did the speaker feel very stressed?
hint: Find the sentence that starts 'Once, I was late for school...' in the stress example.
sample: When I was late for school once.

ja.prompt: 話者はいつとてもストレスを感じましたか？
ja.hint: ストレスの例で『一度、学校に遅れそうで…』という文を探してください。
ja.sample: 学校に遅れそうになったときです。

local.prompt: 說話者是什麼時候感到非常緊張的？
local.hint: 在『有一次我上學遲到了，感到非常緊張。』這句例子中找答案。
local.sample: 當我有一次上學遲到時。

local_pron.prompt: sh Shuōhuà zhě shì shénme shíhòu gǎndào fēicháng jǐnzhāng de?
local_pron.hint: zài 'yǒu yīcì wǒ shàngxué chídào...' zhè jù lǐ zhǎo dā'àn.
local_pron.sample: dāng wǒ yǒu yīcì shàngxué chídào shí.

zh.prompt: 说话者什么时候感到非常紧张？
zh.hint: 在处理压力的例子中找那句“一次，我上学迟到了……”。
zh.sample: 当我有一次上学迟到的时候。

en.prompt: When did the speaker feel very stressed?
en.hint: Refer to the stress example sentence that begins 'Once, I was late for school...'.
en.sample: When I was late for school once.

en_pron.prompt: When did the speaker feel very stressed? (pronunciation help)
en_pron.hint: See 'Once, I was late for school and felt very stressed.'
en_pron.sample: When I was late for school once.
